description: Figure 5 (“entropyavggraphstatic.png”) is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating average entropy values across different sycophancy-reduction methods for static experiments, comparing results across multiple AI models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and “Llama,” ordered left to right, with the axis label “Different AI Models.” The vertical axis is labeled “Entropy (Average Value)” and uses a linear numeric scale spanning approximately from 3.0 up to 6.0, with regularly spaced tick marks at about 0.5-unit intervals. Each model category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries: “Baseline” (pink), “Source Info” (pale yellow), and “Direct Command” (light blue), with the legend shown in the upper-right of the plot area. For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is just under 5.0 (about 4.8–4.9), Source Info is a bit above 5.0 (about 5.2), and Direct Command is slightly above 5.0 (about 5.1). For Claude, Baseline is around 4.7, Source Info is around 5.1, and Direct Command is around 4.9. For Llama, Baseline is around 4.5, Source Info is around 4.9, and Direct Command is around 4.8. The bars are not visually emphasized with outlines or annotations, and the categories appear in a fixed model order rather than being sorted by bar height.
